corrections.claimed_speedup: Bounded dropping queue 6/9 ns vs spdlog 271/360 ns (50th/99.9th, 1 thread); 8/18 vs spdlog 557/1106 (4 threads). Throughput 6.44M msg/s vs spdlog 2.57M (README). Beats g3log (1066 ns) and Boost.Log (3093 ns) at 1 thread; fmtlog and XTR are about equal.
